profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Broadcom
profile.summary:
Languages: C/C++, C#, Java, Python, Assembly, JSP, JavaScript, SQL, HTML
OS: Unix, Linux, Windows, Cisco IOS, QNX
Mobile platforms: RIM Blackberry, JXTA, Google Android, WebOS, Apple iPhone
Networking: Ethernet, LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, UDP, QoS, ACL
SCM: Clearcase, Perforce, AccuRev, Visual Sourcesafe
Tools: SlickEdit, Argo UML, Cygwin, Eclipse, Netbeans, Visual Studio
Certification: CCNA

Specialties: Critical thinking, Technical Leadership, Team Leadership, Software Engineering, Data Structures, Algorithms, Computer Networking, Information Security, Problem Solving, Mathematics, Innovation, Creativity, Startegy, Idea generation

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and implement software modules on DOCSIS Cable Modem, eRouter and Set-top box platforms in C and C++.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software development and enhancing key software components of Java applications such as SMS, MMS, Blackberry Email, File explorer, and related Graphical user interfaces on BlackBerry Handheld mobile devices.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: At start-up, responsible for requirements gathering, project strategy and planning, software architecture definition, detailed software design, coding, project management, and interaction with customers providing technical communication and presentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Writing software modules for networking features on Intel Castine Network Processor for Cisco SIP400 Line-card WAN module which is a part of Cisco 7600 router series and Catalyst 6500 switch.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Intern)
positions.description: Designed the algorithm to merge large fault-log files printed by HP servers to generate reports displaying various results based on differnt parameters. Implemented the GUI Application based on algorithm using Extreme Programming methodology in C#.

positions.title: Software Developer (Intern)
positions.description: Worked on developing large scale distributed multi-tier web based system for Customer response to meet new business requirements using Java/J2EE, JSP, Servlets, Javascript, XML, HTML, Web Services, SQL, UNIX technologies.

positions.title: Software Developer (Intern)
positions.description: Web and database development of Web-based shipment tracking system using ASP, JavaScript, VBscript, SQL, CSS and HTML, unit and integration testing, application integration into web portal, report generation and validation, and data analysis.

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description: Worked on project for Intrusion Detection in Mobile Ad-hoc Networks and prepared malicious Attack Taxonomy for both wired and wireless networking environment.  In addition also worked on Mobility Prediction models and algorithms.
